# Mandatory Page Excellence Toolchain v1

Status: `ACTIVATION_CANDIDATE_FAIL_CLOSED`

This closed-world toolset makes architecture, implementation, runtime, and adoption evidence mandatory for page and interface mutations routed through `AI_ENTRYPOINT.json`.

The universal layer applies to every page. Named award adapters are separate, current-cycle overlays and are not implied by a universal pass.

## Permanent routing law

- No mandatory toolset route → no page construction.
- No required phase receipts → no candidate materialization.
- No runtime evidence → no perceptual acceptance request.
- No acceptance → no public page mutation.

The official mutation entry command invokes `page-operation-entry-gate.v1.mjs`, which verifies the active closed-world toolset bundle, eight instrument registrations, version bindings, thresholds, page-operation phase, and receipt bundle before delegating to the existing repository project router.

## Blind baseline subject

- Immutable visual subject: `2044e7ab5d27af7bcfbd477a6c3ee046549744ed`
- Packaging-only successor: `6c9f32d4ea13905b87f3519f9c18c425ae0e449c`
- User visual inspection: withheld during scoring.
- Screenshots: neither included nor exposed.

The workflow executes deterministic package reproduction, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit runtime tests, phone/tablet/desktop equivalence, axe accessibility execution, keyboard behavior, exact-return scenarios and negative tests, performance measurements, and two-holder score reproduction.

Automated visual and originality scores are bounded proxies based on rendered DOM geometry, contrast, hierarchy, feature differentiation, and runtime behavior. They do not create human perceptual acceptance or named-award readiness.
